presets.name: CANDLELIGHT
presets.prompt: Warm practical illumination produced primarily by candles within the scene. Soft amber light around 2200K to 2600K creates gentle highlights on faces and nearby surfaces while allowing the surrounding environment to fall naturally into deeper warm shadows. Illumination should clearly originate from visible or believable candle positions rather than behaving like modern studio lighting. Subtle irregularity in intensity suggests natural flame without excessive flicker effects. Skin retains realistic dimensionality and texture, highlights remain soft rather than blown out, and background illumination gradually decreases with distance from the candles. Maintain believable warm candlelight direction and exposure throughout the scene.
presets.description: Warm practical candle illumination with natural falloff and soft highlights.

presets.name: TORCHLIGHT
presets.prompt: Warm directional practical lighting generated by medieval flame torches. The primary illumination is a rich amber-orange approximately 2000K to 2400K, producing stronger directional contrast than candlelight, pronounced but natural shadow falloff, warm edge illumination on nearby stone and wood surfaces, and small areas of brighter flame-lit highlights. Light sources should correspond to believable torch positions in the environment. Preserve natural skin tones beneath the warm cast and avoid turning the entire image uniformly orange. Background areas away from the flames remain noticeably darker.
presets.description: Directional amber torch lighting with stronger contrast than candlelight.

presets.name: GOLDEN HOUR
presets.prompt: Late-afternoon golden-hour sunlight entering from a low angle, with warm soft directional illumination approximately 3500K to 4500K. The sun creates long gentle shadows, warm highlights along faces and hair, subtle rim illumination around subjects, and soft atmospheric depth in the environment. Maintain realistic dynamic range with detailed highlights rather than overexposed glowing edges. Ambient sky light provides cooler subtle fill within the shadows, creating natural warm-to-cool color contrast.
presets.description: Low-angle warm sunlight with long shadows and subtle rim light.

presets.name: MOONLIT NIGHT
presets.prompt: Naturalistic nighttime illumination dominated by cool moonlight, with a soft blue-gray directional key light suggesting a bright moon outside the frame. Shadows remain deep but retain subtle environmental detail rather than becoming pure black. Moonlit surfaces receive gentle cool highlights and subdued contrast, while any practical lamps, candles or fires retain their own warmer color temperatures. Avoid artificial bright-blue lighting or an unrealistic daytime exposure. The scene should clearly read as nighttime.
presets.description: Cool blue-gray moonlight key with deep but detailed shadows.

presets.name: SOFT OVERCAST
presets.prompt: Soft diffuse daylight beneath a fully overcast sky, creating broad even illumination with very soft-edged shadows and restrained highlights. Color temperature remains neutral to slightly cool. Faces receive flattering natural illumination without obvious directional key lighting. Surface textures and colors remain visible and realistic, contrast is moderate to low, and the background retains detail without harsh sunlight or dramatic rim lighting.
presets.description: Even diffuse overcast daylight with soft shadows and low contrast.
